method: Selected free official product and payment-system documentation. No authenticated APIs, production funds, contractual eligibility or performance tests. Availability is not claim verification. Historical ramp-onboarding-dataset.json remains unchanged.

observations.observation: Documents buy/sell quotes, transaction lookup, configuration discovery and virtual accounts.
observations.boundary: Does not establish each customer's live corridor eligibility.

observations.scope: Payment methods and current BRL purchase notice
observations.observation: Lists PIX for BRL purchases in Brazil, with a temporary notice about other BRL purchase methods.
observations.boundary: Do not infer PIX payouts from a purchase-method listing; recheck the live configuration.

observations.observation: On Ramp supported; Off Ramp and Stream Off Ramp unsupported; Standard KYC requires provider-widget document/liveness step.
observations.boundary: Not a statement that every Transak product lacks off-ramp. Backend allowlisting and account enablement apply.

observations.observation: Agreement-based access, backend orchestration and a documented bank-transfer sell flow.
observations.boundary: Not self-serve access or a production-support guarantee for every partner.

observations.observation: Production key must be valid and off-ramp feature enabled.
observations.boundary: Configuration and eligibility must match the intended customer and route.

observations.observation: Documents geolocation-aware assets and direction-specific quotes.

observations.observation: Application-based hosted, embedded and mobile component purchase integrations.

observations.observation: Documents pay-ins, transfers, liquidation addresses, rail endorsements and customer-type/direction distinctions. References changed endorsement requirements effective June 15, 2026.

observations.observation: Documents virtual accounts, transfers, liquidation addresses, rail endorsement and CLABE validation.
observations.boundary: Direct public Markdown HTTP 200; not a production payout test or universal beneficiary approval.

observations.scope: Exchange-rate endpoint; source includes March 2026 supported-pair statement
observations.observation: Describes rates as estimates, not time-locked quotes.
observations.boundary: Direct public Markdown HTTP 200; not a review of every possible commercial execution arrangement.

observations.scope: Current Mint eligibility and product overview

observations.observation: Describes aggregation, on-ramp, off-ramp, swaps, routing and headless products.

observations.scope: Current account and payment menu; former conduit.financial address redirects

observations.observation: Describes ramps, payments, deposits, payouts and verification, including local rails.

observations.observation: Describes fraud, identity, bank verification, AML and monitoring tools.

observations.observation: Describes stablecoin liquidity linked to PIX and SPEI business flows.
observations.boundary: Historical publication date preserved. Do not republish its speed, financial, authorization or benchmark claims as independently verified results.
